sections.text: The black goat ate my letter!

Ability Power 60. Heals the HP of all allies.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Removes buffs from all enemies.
-Removes damage reflection, continuous healing, and damage reduction effects from all enemies.
-Reduces Ability cooldown times (except for certain Abilities) for all allies by 30% for 50 seconds.
-Increases the Unison gauge gains of all allies by 3 for 50 seconds.
-Recovers 20 Cost for all allies.
-Applies Awakening standby mode (activates Awakening for 60 seconds when HP drops below 60%) to yourself.
-Casts Deconstructive Collapse (nullifies all buffs) on the enemy Field for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 8000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 8000
